grounding_note: feet_near_ground checks only collision-bottom geometry; contact forces are diagnostic, not a standing requirement.
sampling: uniform without replacement within each family
controller: Low-level balance/IK; zero high-level deltas; saved gripper target; Level02 table motion
note: Candidate measurements use the saved candidate ID in the object's current pose; offsets are in the candidate frame, and rotation offsets are local roll/pitch/yaw. Object yaw is relative to the normal reset orientation. Full-task candidate fields are null. saved_geometry records the bank frame, whereas the other measurements are after preview physics. Near-goal saved_grasp_evidence comes from offline construction; current finger contact forces are net body-force diagnostics; the fixed finger may be merged into link06 by fixed-joint collapsing. They are not object-specific contacts or a one-frame proof of a stable grasp.
